paragraphs: Yuchasin cites from Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:4: “the father of Rav Tzafra asked Rabbi Zeira”; the Jerusalem Talmud text Hyman uses reads Rav Safra.[^1]

notes.text: The saved whole Guggenheimer Kilayim 9:4 paragraph reads ‘the father of Rav Safra asked Rabbi Zeira,’ supporting the local expansion of ר״ז. Rav Tzafra remains Hyman’s reported Yuchasin form; Yuchasin has not been freshly collated, and no father or alias identity is admitted.
